name: University of Ottawa
header:
University of Ottawa
Canada · MSc Mathematics and Statistics, Mathematics concentration; PhD Mathematics and Statistics (OCIMS)
QS Mathematics 2026 world rank 301-350. Additional research-fit program; outside Canada top ten including ties. Official QS
public table verified 5 November 2026; rank bands have no internal ordering.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• OGS deadline precedes the ordinary mathematics application deadline by months; start its separate referee
process promptly.
• This undergraduate applicant normally enters the MSc; the PhD master’s prerequisite must not be
overlooked.
• Do not send extra papers or essays: unsolicited admissions documents are deleted.
• Walter Burgess, Daniel Daigle, Barry Jessup, Erhard Neher, Michel Racine and Damien Roy are explicitly
emeritus in the current directory; not presented as ordinary new-student advisers.
• Core shortlist covers current algebra/number-theory/representation faculty; Maia Fraser’s current work is
mainly machine learning and contact/symplectic geometry, outside the requested core complex/algebraic
fields. Higher category theory and low-dimensional topology are not equated with algebraic geometry.
• A named supervisor and international funding evidence are substantive pre-enrolment requirements, not
optional suggestions.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago mathematics bachelor’s can qualify for the MSc with a related four-year honours-equivalent degree
and B+/75% equivalent, subject to research preparation and supervisor acceptance. The normal PhD requires
a relevant master’s at B+/75%; bachelor’s-only direct PhD was not established. Ottawa MSc students can seek
PhD transfer within 16 months after two graduate courses each A−, a basic comprehensive examination,
research progress, supervisor/advisory recommendations and committee approval. International applicants
must demonstrate financial support. F-1 status is not a Canadian study permit. [s3] [s4] [s5] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Select the MSc thesis/project/course route; for research, contact supervisors early. Catalogue requires a
supervisor name when applying, and acceptance by registration. Arrange two academic referees. Submit and
pay through OUAC; uoZone credentials normally follow within one week (follow up after two). Upload required
documents and add referees there. OGS can precede the admission application; external candidates request a
scholarship-portal account through the published awards-office route. [s3] [s5] [s2] [s11]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Contact potential supervisors early and name a supervisor in the initial research application; acceptance
required by registration. Hadi Salmasian’s current personal page explicitly advertises MSc/PhD openings and
welcomes strong undergraduate algebra preparation. Other faculty availability for autumn 2027 is
unconfirmed. OCIMS is joint with Carleton, but an Ottawa application is not an application to every Carleton
supervisor. [s3] [s4] [s5] [s20] [s1]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use OUAC first, then the supplied uoZone account and uoDoc checklist. Public program-specific requirements
require selecting the degree/program then Find; both mathematics results were retrieved and saved without

making an application. OGS uses a different Online Scholarships portal; its assessment PDFs must be
completed in Adobe Acrobat Reader/Pro to avoid blank fields. [s2] [s5] [s14]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
OGS explicitly covers 2027-28 and is open; admissions selector is undated standing guidance, so the fall
February 1 rule still needs explicit 2027 confirmation. Fees are current from September 2026. Faculty sources
were checked through 2026 papers. [s5] [s10] [s11] [s17] [s21] [s23] [s27]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Standing rule]
Standing public selector: February 1 for fall and summer; September 1 for winter, for both international and
Canadian applicants and both MSc and PhD. It publishes no year or timezone, so February 1, 2027 is NOT yet a
verified cycle-specific deadline. All required materials must arrive by that deadline; later consideration is
capacity-dependent, not a guaranteed extension. [s5]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
OGS 2027-28: candidate application November 19, 2026 at 1 p.m.; separate reference extension to November
25, 2026 at 1 p.m. Live English and French pages agree. Referee PDF identifies Eastern Time, whereas the
deadline webpages omit timezone. Earlier search-index dates November 12/18 are superseded by live pages.
Admission/Special Merit award consideration accompanies admission; no separate mathematics
funding-priority deadline was found. [s11] [s12] [s13] [s14] [s8] [s9]
Reference receipt [Conflict]
Admission letters must arrive by the academic application deadline (standing February 1 for fall). OGS reports:
November 25, 2026, 1 p.m. ET in the linked guidelines, six days after the candidate deadline; see the
contradictory portal-submission language under source conflicts. [s2] [s5] [s11] [s13] [s14]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Required language evidence is part of the complete package due by the program deadline. No separate score
grace period, 2027 timestamp, or GRE deadline is published in the inspected mathematics checklist. [s5]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
All application documents due by the program deadline. OUAC submission alone is incomplete; allow time for
uoZone access and referee submissions. Official records are supplied after an offer only as specified by its
conditions. OGS supporting files due with the November 19, 2026 application; referee reports have the explicit
November 25 extension. [s5] [s2] [s11]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
Accept through uoZone by the individual offer’s stated date. No universal mathematics acceptance date was
established. Central deposit language targets certificates/diplomas and should not be imported into this
MSc/PhD. [s2]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Conflict]
Conflicting TOEFL conversion: mathematics selector lists old-scale 84 overall, writing 24, other sections 20, and
“New TOEFL 4”; current central page gives post-January 21, 2026 overall 4.5, writing/reading/listening 4.5 and
speaking 4 (old-scale equivalents 86/21/22/20/20). Both give IELTS 6.5 overall/writing, other bands 6. Central
alternatives: Cambridge 170/160, PTE 60/59, CAEL 70/60. MyBest is accepted centrally. Mathematics requires
good English writing even if French proficient. Confirm the applicable conversion if a test is needed. [s2] [s5]

Likely eligible by inference after completing at least two full-time years at UChicago where English is the sole

Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload copies of every university transcript, including unfinished study, exchanges, visiting/nondegree study,
letters of permission and distance courses. For documents not in English/French, provide certified translations
of transcripts and degree certificates. Post-offer official documents follow the specific offer conditions. OGS
separately needs current Fall 2026-issued registrar transcripts, all previous postsecondary study and
applicable legends, combined into ONE PDF; student-account screenshots are insufficient. [s5] [s11] [s12]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two admission recommendations for either degree, academic referees preferred. They should be able to
assess research ability; English or French letters are permitted. [s5] [s2]
Scholarship references [2027 confirmed]
OGS needs two separate academic assessment reports from distinct referees, using its own form rather than
assumed admission-letter reuse. Exact assessment prompt: “Please provide your overall assessment of the
candidate’s academic qualifications and potential, with comments to justify your evaluation” (maximum 4,500
characters). Applicant prefills identification, attaches the form to each request; referee completes and uploads
it. [s11] [s13]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Admission: after OUAC submission and uoZone access, enter referee contact details in the admission file; a
confidential secure-form email follows. The public guide does not specify a separate send button. OGS: enter
details, attach the prefilled assessment PDF and explicitly click Send request; the portal’s FR/EN language at
that moment determines the invitation language. [s2] [s11] [s14]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Admission invitations are downstream of the initial paid OUAC application; supporting documents and
references complete that application later. OGS requests can be sent before final scholarship submission. Do
not confuse these two submission stages. [s2] [s11] [s14]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Admission progress is tracked in uoZone, but the exact applicant-facing letter-receipt indicator was not publicly
verified. OGS guidelines explicitly show a successful-upload confirmation for referees; applicants cannot view
the confidential report text. [s2] [s14]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
No public mathematics-specific rule was found for updating an uploaded admission letter or carrying it to
another cycle/application. OGS has a separate current form and portal process; do not assume reuse. Ask

gradsci@uottawa.ca about corrections; scholarship problems go to loansandawards@uOttawa.ca. [s2] [s5] [s13]
[s14]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required résumé for admission; page/word limit and specialized content prompt not published. Upload through
uoDoc using its general file rules. OGS separately requires a résumé generated inside its scholarship portal; an
independently designed CV is not a substitute there. [s5] [s11]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required letter of intent. Exact public prompt: “A letter of intent outlining your career goals and proposed
research area.” No word/page/font limit published. Upload as a requested uoDoc document; no link-only
alternative is stated. [s5] [s2]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate personal/background statement is requested by the public mathematics admission checklist.
There is no published prompt, limit or permission to add unsolicited uploads/links. Catalogue references to
evidence of research ability do not by themselves create an extra upload requirement. Scholarship
requirements are separate. [s5] [s3]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Required within the letter of intent; identify the proposed research area. A separate research-interest essay is
not listed. Limit and detailed formatting unverified. [s5]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
No separate full research proposal is requested by the public mathematics admission checklist. There is no
published prompt, limit or permission to add unsolicited uploads/links. Catalogue references to evidence of
research ability do not by themselves create an extra upload requirement. Scholarship requirements are
separate. [s5] [s3]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
No separate writing sample, thesis or research summary is requested by the public mathematics admission
checklist. There is no published prompt, limit or permission to add unsolicited uploads/links. Catalogue
references to evidence of research ability do not by themselves create an extra upload requirement.
Scholarship requirements are separate. [s5] [s3]
Publications list [Standing rule]
No separate publications list is requested by the public mathematics admission checklist. There is no published
prompt, limit or permission to add unsolicited uploads/links. Catalogue references to evidence of research
ability do not by themselves create an extra upload requirement. Scholarship requirements are separate. [s5]
[s3]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
No separate mathematics course list or course-description document appears in the complete public MSc/PhD
checklist; transcript is required. No prompt or length is therefore published for a separate item. Do not upload
unsolicited material. [s5]
Scholarship essays [2027 confirmed]
OGS 2027-28 requires a portal-generated CV and a research/program statement with contributions (faithful
paraphrase of the field label), maximum 700 words; optional bibliography/citations up to 1,250 words.
Supporting uploads must be PDF. Two special assessment reports are separate. Portal-only subquestions and
font/page formatting remain unverified. QEII sponsorship or no-sponsor letter is irrelevant if applying solely as
an international OGS candidate. [s11]

Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
International financial-support evidence is explicitly required: supervisor stipend combined with scholarships
and/or trust funds. No separate application essay beyond the résumé and intent letter is listed. General uoDoc
rules: individual files, preferably PDF, maximum 10 MB; short filenames without special characters; uploads
cannot be changed/deleted and unsolicited files are removed. [s5] [s2]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
No universal mathematics MSc annual guarantee was found. Special Merit awards are considered
automatically, but faculty sets amount/duration. Central PhD admission scholarship may provide at least CAD
72,000 across four years (CAD 18,000/year): CAD 9,000/year scholarship plus at least CAD 9,000/year
academic-unit assistantships/internal awards. This is an award with eligibility/offer conditions, not an
unconditional stipend for every admit; tuition/fees are not explicitly waived. OGS is CAD 5,000/term, up to CAD
15,000 for one year. [s8] [s9] [s11]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Central doctoral admission scholarship: twelve consecutive full-time terms, normally four years. MSc Special
Merit duration is faculty-dependent and unpublished. OGS: at least two consecutive full-time terms, up to
three, nonrenewable; start May 2027, September 2027 or January 2028. These award durations differ from
nominal degree lengths (MSc thesis two years; project/course one; PhD four). [s8] [s9] [s11] [s3] [s4]
International eligibility [2027 confirmed]
International applicants can receive doctoral admission scholarships and Special Merit awards. OGS
international competition allows candidates without a Canadian visa/permit at application, provided valid proof
is supplied before award activation; this differs from some Ontario universities. QEII-GSST excludes
international students. Do not infer Canadian citizenship/residency from UChicago attendance. [s9] [s8] [s11]
[s12]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Doctoral admission award normally requires at least 8.0/10 admission average and continuous full-time
registration; an external scholarship may reduce the unit-funded half. OGS for a new graduate applicant
requires at least A−/8.0 in EACH of the last two completed years. Award-start limits: at most four completed
MSc terms or thirteen PhD terms. Lifetime government-graduate-award cap six years (MSc maximum two; PhD
four); prohibited concurrent awards apply. Confirm actual tuition, mandatory fees, summer coverage and TA
workload in the offer. [s9] [s12]
Extra funding application [2027 confirmed]
Special Merit is automatic with admission. OGS needs a separate application to the Faculty of Science
competition at each intended university; awards are not transferable between institutions/faculties. Applicants
without an Ottawa account can request scholarship-portal access by email with name, email and language
preference before submitting an admission application. No outreach was undertaken. [s8] [s11] [s12]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Department/supervisor TA and RA support, Special Merit, OGS, external awards and Mitacs are listed by central
funding. Differential tuition exemptions may exist for qualifying French-language study; eligibility for this
English mathematics route was not established, so do not budget one. National scholarship
citizenship/residency rules require individual review. [s7] [s8] [s9]
Application fee [Standing rule]
CAD 125, nonrefundable, paid through OUAC. The mathematics selector and university fee schedule effective
September 1, 2026 agree. [s5] [s10]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
No mathematics or graduate-wide international hardship fee-waiver mechanism was found in targeted official

searches, admissions steps or the fee schedule. Ask the program before payment; the published fee is
nonrefundable. This is an evidence gap, not a claim that waivers are categorically impossible. [s2] [s5] [s10]

Pay attention to
• OGS deadline precedes the ordinary mathematics application deadline by months; start its separate referee
process promptly.
• This undergraduate applicant normally enters the MSc; the PhD master’s prerequisite must not be
overlooked.
• Do not send extra papers or essays: unsolicited admissions documents are deleted.
• Walter Burgess, Daniel Daigle, Barry Jessup, Erhard Neher, Michel Racine and Damien Roy are explicitly
emeritus in the current directory; not presented as ordinary new-student advisers.
• Core shortlist covers current algebra/number-theory/representation faculty; Maia Fraser’s current work is
mainly machine learning and contact/symplectic geometry, outside the requested core complex/algebraic
fields. Higher category theory and low-dimensional topology are not equated with algebraic geometry.
• A named supervisor and international funding evidence are substantive pre-enrolment requirements, not
optional suggestions.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago mathematics bachelor’s can qualify for the MSc with a related four-year honours-equivalent degree
and B+/75% equivalent, subject to research preparation and supervisor acceptance. The normal PhD requires
a relevant master’s at B+/75%; bachelor’s-only direct PhD was not established. Ottawa MSc students can seek
PhD transfer within 16 months after two graduate courses each A−, a basic comprehensive examination,
research progress, supervisor/advisory recommendations and committee approval. International applicants
must demonstrate financial support. F-1 status is not a Canadian study permit. [s3] [s4] [s5] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Select the MSc thesis/project/course route; for research, contact supervisors early. Catalogue requires a
supervisor name when applying, and acceptance by registration. Arrange two academic referees. Submit and
pay through OUAC; uoZone credentials normally follow within one week (follow up after two). Upload required
documents and add referees there. OGS can precede the admission application; external candidates request a
scholarship-portal account through the published awards-office route. [s3] [s5] [s2] [s11]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Contact potential supervisors early and name a supervisor in the initial research application; acceptance
required by registration. Hadi Salmasian’s current personal page explicitly advertises MSc/PhD openings and
welcomes strong undergraduate algebra preparation. Other faculty availability for autumn 2027 is
unconfirmed. OCIMS is joint with Carleton, but an Ottawa application is not an application to every Carleton
supervisor. [s3] [s4] [s5] [s20] [s1]

Use OUAC first, then the supplied uoZone account and uoDoc checklist. Public program-specific requirements
require selecting the degree/program then Find; both mathematics results were retrieved and saved without

Pay attention to
• OGS deadline precedes the ordinary mathematics application deadline by months; start its separate referee
process promptly.
• This undergraduate applicant normally enters the MSc; the PhD master’s prerequisite must not be
overlooked.
• Do not send extra papers or essays: unsolicited admissions documents are deleted.
• Walter Burgess, Daniel Daigle, Barry Jessup, Erhard Neher, Michel Racine and Damien Roy are explicitly
emeritus in the current directory; not presented as ordinary new-student advisers.
• Core shortlist covers current algebra/number-theory/representation faculty; Maia Fraser’s current work is
mainly machine learning and contact/symplectic geometry, outside the requested core complex/algebraic
fields. Higher category theory and low-dimensional topology are not equated with algebraic geometry.
• A named supervisor and international funding evidence are substantive pre-enrolment requirements, not
optional suggestions.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago mathematics bachelor’s can qualify for the MSc with a related four-year honours-equivalent degree
and B+/75% equivalent, subject to research preparation and supervisor acceptance. The normal PhD requires
a relevant master’s at B+/75%; bachelor’s-only direct PhD was not established. Ottawa MSc students can seek
PhD transfer within 16 months after two graduate courses each A−, a basic comprehensive examination,
research progress, supervisor/advisory recommendations and committee approval. International applicants
must demonstrate financial support. F-1 status is not a Canadian study permit. [s3] [s4] [s5] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Select the MSc thesis/project/course route; for research, contact supervisors early. Catalogue requires a
supervisor name when applying, and acceptance by registration. Arrange two academic referees. Submit and
pay through OUAC; uoZone credentials normally follow within one week (follow up after two). Upload required
documents and add referees there. OGS can precede the admission application; external candidates request a
scholarship-portal account through the published awards-office route. [s3] [s5] [s2] [s11]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Contact potential supervisors early and name a supervisor in the initial research application; acceptance
required by registration. Hadi Salmasian’s current personal page explicitly advertises MSc/PhD openings and
welcomes strong undergraduate algebra preparation. Other faculty availability for autumn 2027 is
unconfirmed. OCIMS is joint with Carleton, but an Ottawa application is not an application to every Carleton
supervisor. [s3] [s4] [s5] [s20] [s1]

Use OUAC first, then the supplied uoZone account and uoDoc checklist. Public program-specific requirements
require selecting the degree/program then Find; both mathematics results were retrieved and saved without
